# Repository social preview

`social-preview.jpg` is a still from Gökay's Video 2 GLSL character demo, used for the GitHub repository's link preview.

- Article: https://x.com/gokayfem/status/2112184819115336014
- Source video: https://x.com/gokayfem/status/2111907592129671505
- Frame: 00:46

To update it, open the repository's Settings → General → Social preview → Edit → Upload an image.
GitHub accepts PNG, JPEG or GIF files under 1 MB. The saved file is a static preview; the source post contains the animation.
